tools.name: trade_check
tools.description: Deterministic pre-trade economics check for a long (buy) round trip. Call it before placing a trade: given size, entry/exit reference prices, maker/taker roles, fees, spread and slippage, it returns whether the trade still clears after all costs (result.economically_clears, result.reason), the net P

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "trade_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
